statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is a nonnegative integer less than 2^32, and for every bit position b with 0 <= b < 32, bit b of r is 1 if and only if the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that bit b of nums[i] is 1 is at least k. Here bit b of a nonnegative integer x means (floor(x / 2^b)) mod 2. Also, for every bit position b >= 32, bit b of r is 0.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is a nonnegative integer and r < 2^32; equivalently, 0 <= r <= 2^32 - 1.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: For every nums and k satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the unique nonnegative integer less than 2^32 such that, for every bit position b with 0 <= b < 32, bit b of r is 1 if and only if there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) for which bit b of nums[i] is 1; equivalently, r equals the bitwise OR of all elements of nums.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; 1 <= k <= len(nums); and k = 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the unique nonnegative integer less than 2^32 such that, for every bit position b with 0 <= b < 32, bit b of r is 1 if and only if every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) has bit b of nums[i] equal to 1; equivalently, r equals the bitwise AND of all elements of nums.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; 1 <= k <= len(nums); and k = len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = nums[0].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; 1 <= k <= len(nums); and len(nums) = 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is a nonnegative integer less than 2^32 and, for every bit position b with 0 <= b < 32, if bit b of r is 1 then there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that bit b of nums[i] is 1. Equivalently, every 1-bit of r is also a 1-bit of the bitwise OR of all elements of nums.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is a nonnegative integer less than 2^32 and, for every bit position b with 0 <= b < 32, if bit b of nums[i] is 1 for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), then bit b of r is 1. Equivalently, every 1-bit of the bitwise AND of all elements of nums is also a 1-bit of r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: If the function returns r1 on input (nums, k1) and returns r2 on input (nums, k2), then r1 and r2 are nonnegative integers less than 2^32 and, for every bit position b with 0 <= b < 32, if bit b of r2 is 1 then bit b of r1 is 1. Equivalently, every 1-bit of the K-or with threshold k2 is also a 1-bit of the K-or with threshold k1.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; and 1 <= k1 <= k2 <= len(nums).

statement: If the function returns r on input (nums, k) and returns r' on input (nums2, k), then r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; 1 <= k <= len(nums); len(nums2) = len(nums); for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), 0 <= nums2[j] < 2^32; and nums2 is a permutation of nums, meaning that for every integer v, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v equals the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(nums2) and nums2[j] = v.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is a nonnegative integer less than 2^32 and, for every bit position b with 0 <= b < 32, if bit b of r is 1 then the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that bit b of nums[i] is 1 is at least k. Equivalently, every set bit of r has at least k distinct witnesses in nums.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is a nonnegative integer less than 2^32 and, for every bit position b with 0 <= b < 32, if bit b of r is 0 then the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that bit b of nums[i] is 1 is at most k - 1. Equivalently, a bit with fewer than k witnesses is cleared in r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; and 1 <= k <= len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 50; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] < 2^32; 1 <= k <= len(nums); and for every bit position b with 0 <= b < 32, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that bit b of nums[i] is 1 is less than k.
